extracted.intended_audience: research organisations, companies, and public sector entities seeking funding from the Research Council of Norway
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and high-level requirements for organisations seeking funding from the Research Council of Norway, including who may apply, timelines, portfolio alignment, and where to find calls and results. Intended to orient prospective applicants to procedural and eligibility expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — Who can apply
rubrics_metrics.description: Research organisations, companies and entities in the public sector can apply for funding from the Research Council of Norway.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this as the primary eligibility rule: applying parties should be organizations (research institutions, companies, public sector entities). Individual applicants are not listed here; check specific calls for any variations or additional eligibility restrictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadlines and nomination dates
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Observe specific deadlines published for each call or award. 'Nominate by 15 September' is an example—applicants must check the relevant call for the exact deadline and submission instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Calls for proposals — use current calls
rubrics_metrics.description: See calls for proposals. See all calls for proposals, both current and closed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should consult the calls-for-proposals section to find current opportunities, requirements, and archived (closed) calls for reference. Each call contains the detailed requirements, assessment criteria, and application documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Portfolio alignment — investment decision structure
rubrics_metrics.description: We have divided our investments into 12 project portfolios. Each portfolio has a board responsible for investing in the best projects within its portfolio area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals are considered within portfolio priorities; applicants should align project objectives with the relevant portfolio area. Portfolio boards select projects they consider 'best' for that area—check portfolio descriptions for priority topics and priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application results transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: See application results from all evaluated proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation outcomes are published; applicants can consult published results to understand success rates and decisions. Use published results to benchmark proposals and learn about past funded projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant support and contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Our answer service is designed to provide you with correct, safe and quick answers across the entire Research Council. You can choose to log in and follow your question, or you can use an open form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Council's contact/answer service for procedural questions, clarifications about calls, and submission issues. Logging in allows follow-up tracking; the open form is available for general inquiries.
